sentences.en: MAN: Hello?
sentences.zh: MAN: 你好？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Hi
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你好。

sentences.en: It's Laura Carlton here
sentences.zh: 我是劳拉·卡尔顿。

sentences.en: We've just arrived at the holiday flat, but can't get the hot water and heating to work
sentences.zh: 我们刚到度假公寓，但热水器和暖气都打不开。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh right!
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，明白了！

sentences.en: That's easy
sentences.zh: 这很简单。

sentences.en: Don't worry
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: In the upstairs cupboard, you'll find the water heater
sentences.zh: upstairs 柜子里有热水器。

sentences.en: You'll see three main controls on the left at the bottom of the heater
sentences.zh: 你会在热水器底部左侧看到三个主要控制旋钮。

sentences.en: The first one - the round one on the far left - is the most important one for the heating and hot water
sentences.zh: 第一个——最左边的圆形旋钮——对供暖和热水来说最重要。

sentences.en: It's the main control switch
sentences.zh: 这是主控开关。

sentences.en: Make sure it's in the 'on' position
sentences.zh: 请确保它处于‘开启’位置。

sentences.en: The switch itself doesn't light up, but the little square below will be black if the switch is 'off'
sentences.zh: 开关本身不会亮灯，但如果开关处于‘关闭’状态，其下方的小方块会呈黑色。

sentences.en: That's probably what's happened - it's got switched off by mistake
sentences.zh: 很可能就是这种情况——它被不小心关掉了。

sentences.en: The middle one of these three controls - you'll see it's slightly larger than the first one - controls - the radiators
sentences.zh: 这三个控制旋钮中间那个——你会看到它比第一个稍大一些——控制散热器。

sentences.en: If you feel cold while you're there and need the radiators on, this needs to be turned to maximum
sentences.zh: 如果你们待在那里觉得冷、需要打开散热器，这个旋钮需调至最大档。

sentences.en: The last of the three controls - the one on the right - is usually on about a number four setting which for the water in the taps iS usually quite hot enough
sentences.zh: 这三个控制旋钮中最后一个——最右边的那个——通常设定在数字四的位置，水龙头里的水温一般已足够热。

sentences.en: V Below the heating controls in the middle is a small round plastic button, 12) 1 812 there isn't enough water in the pipes, sometimes the heater goes out
sentences.zh: V 加热控制装置正中间下方有一个小圆形塑料按钮，12) 1 812 如果管道内水量不足，有时热水器会自动熄火。

sentences.en: If this happens you'll need to press this button to reset the heater
sentences.zh: 若发生这种情况，你需要按一下这个按钮来重置热水器。

sentences.en: Hold it in n for about five seconds and the heater should come on again
sentences.zh: 按住它约五秒钟，热水器就应重新启动。

sentences.en: Then there's a little square indicator under the third knob that's a kind of alarm light
sentences.zh: 第三个旋钮下方还有一个小方形指示灯，是一种报警灯。

sentences.en: It'll flash if you need to reset the heater
sentences.zh: 若需重置热水器，该灯会闪烁。

sentences.en: WOMAN: It sounds complicated
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来挺复杂的……

sentences.en: MAN: I'm sure you won't have any problems with it
sentences.zh: MAN: 我相信你们不会遇到任何问题。

sentences.en: There should be some more instructions on the side of the heater
sentences.zh: 热水器侧面应该还有一些更详细的说明。

sentences.en: Call me back if you can't make it work
sentences.zh: 如果还是无法启动，再打电话给我。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: While you're on the phone, we haven't managed to find a few things we need, like extra pillows for the beds and some washing powder
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 趁你还在电话里，我们还没找到几样必需品，比如床上用的额外枕头和洗衣粉。

sentences.en: Is there any here?
sentences.zh: 这里有吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Pillows ... ves
sentences.zh: MAN: 枕头……有。

sentences.en: If you look in the cupboard, the large white one upstairs - to the left of the bathroom door - there should be four or five on the top shelf
sentences.zh: 请查看柜子——楼上那间大的白色柜子，就在浴室门左侧——顶层架子上应该放着四五个。

sentences.en: And if you want to do some washing, there's some powder for that .. probably by the back door
sentences.zh: 如果想洗衣服，那里也有洗衣粉……大概放在后门附近。

sentences.en: There's a kind of shelf there above the sink
sentences.zh: 水槽上方有个类似搁板的地方。

sentences.en: In fact, I'm sure there's some there, in a large blue box
sentences.zh: 事实上，我确定那里有一盒，装在一个大的蓝色纸盒里。

sentences.en: You need about half a cup full for each wash
sentences.zh: 每次洗涤大约需要半杯量。

sentences.en: And that reminds me, the spare key to the back door is hanging on a hook on the wall by the sitting room window
sentences.zh: 另外提醒一下，后门的备用钥匙挂在客厅窗户旁墙上的挂钩上。

sentences.en: Please make sure to put it back when you've used it
sentences.zh: 使用后请务必将其放回原处。

sentences.en: The previous guests lost it in the garden and I had to get another one made!
sentences.zh: 之前的房客把它弄丢在花园里了，我不得不重新配了一把！

sentences.en: And if you have any trouble with the lamps, you'll find some spare bulbs in a large cardboard box
sentences.zh: 如果灯具出了问题，备用灯泡放在一个大纸箱里。

sentences.en: It's on top of the washing machine with all kinds of useful things in it
sentences.zh: 箱子就放在洗衣机顶上，里面还放着各种有用的东西。

sentences.en: Oh, and another thing I forgot to mention when we last spoke
sentences.zh: 哦，还有一件事，我上次和您通话时忘了提……

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦？

sentences.en: MAN: I've left you a local map, so you'll be able to find your way around easily
sentences.zh: MAN: 我给您留了一份本地地图，这样您就能轻松找到路了。

sentences.en: It shows the whole area. put it in the top drawer of the chest under the TV in your bedroom
sentences.zh: 地图涵盖了整个区域，我把它放在您卧室电视机下方那个柜子的最上面抽屉里了。

sentences.en: There's a whole file of local information in there too
sentences.zh: 里面还有一个装满本地信息的文件夹。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Thanks
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 谢谢。

sentences.en: What about visiting the town?
sentences.zh: 那去镇上逛逛呢？

sentences.en: Can you give us any advice?
sentences.zh: 您能给我们一些建议吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes
sentences.zh: MAN: 当然可以。

sentences.en: You'll need to take the car
sentences.zh: 您得开车去。

sentences.en: It's too far to walk from the flat really
sentences.zh: 从公寓步行过去确实太远了。

sentences.en: You have to pay to leave your car in all the car parks now I'm afraid
sentences.zh: 恐怕现在所有停车场停车都要收费……

sentences.en: I like the one that's by the station best and you can walk to the town centre from there in five minutes
sentences.zh: 我个人最喜欢火车站旁边的那个停车场，从那儿步行五分钟就能到镇中心。

sentences.en: That's where all the best restaurants are
sentences.zh: 那里集中了所有最好的餐馆。

sentences.en: But if you want a takeaway, the Italian one does really good pasta and pizzas
sentences.zh: 不过如果您想点外卖，那家意大利餐厅的意面和披萨做得特别棒。

sentences.en: Call 7-3 double 2, 8-1 for that one, or 7 double 6, 7 double 1, 9 for the Chinese
sentences.zh: 那家店的电话是7-3双2、8-1；中餐馆的电话是7双6、7双1、9。

sentences.en: They're both good and they'll both deliver to the flat
sentences.zh: 两家都很不错，而且都能把餐送到公寓。

sentences.en: As for places to visit, yes, do go and see the railway museum
sentences.zh: 至于值得参观的地方，对，一定要去看看铁路博物馆。

sentences.en: The exhibition is small but really good
sentences.zh: 展览规模虽小，但内容非常精彩。

sentences.en: It gets very crowded on Sundays, so I suggest you visit it on a quieter day, later in the week, but not on Thursdays which is market day you won't find anywhere to park and it's also the only day of the week when they're not open!
sentences.zh: 周日人会非常多，所以我建议您选一周中人少些的日子去，比如周中稍晚些时候；但请避开周四，因为那天是集市日——您根本找不到停车位，而且那也是博物馆每周唯一不开放的日子！

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的问题吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Not for the moment
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 目前没有了。

sentences.en: Thanks!
sentences.zh: 谢谢！
